_comment: The editorial layer. Everything else in this corpus is derived from the file system, from Cargo.toml, or from the prose itself; these are the two things a machine cannot derive: which trees are Chinese by default, and one sentence per node a reader may land on. Keep blurbs to one sentence — a site shows them under a title, not as a paragraph.

projects.name: Krystallizer
projects.blurb: Agent 记忆核心：会话控制、原子事实图、向量着陆检索；Rust core，可作为 HTTP 服务跑，也可进程内链接。
projects.blurb_en: The agent memory core: session control, an atomic-fact graph, vector-landing retrieval — a Rust core you can run as an HTTP service or link in-process.

projects.name: OKM
projects.blurb: ORM 的 KV 对应物：声明式模型加代码生成，跑在 Fjall 之上。
projects.blurb_en: The KV counterpart of an ORM: declarative models and code generation, over Fjall.

projects.name: Effector
projects.blurb: 技能的远程执行端：把决策变成作用，宿主握协议细节，插件只写业务。
projects.blurb_en: The remote effector for skills: it turns a decision into an effect, the host holds the protocol and the plugin writes only its business.

projects.name: Gravity
projects.blurb: 轮次执行器：无状态 agent 架构里的那一层，纯 Rust，摊位是 induction 的原生子进程。
projects.blurb_en: The turn executor of the stateless agent architecture: pure Rust, hosted as an induction native subprocess.

projects.name: Prism
projects.blurb: 连接面：承载 Aura actor 的 WS 网关，无状态 agent 栈的入口。
projects.blurb_en: The connection plane: a WS gateway hosting Aura actors, the entry point of the stateless agent stack.

projects.name: Aura
projects.blurb: 单状态分布式 Actor 引擎：计算与存储一体，没有 SQL，也没有外部缓存锁。
projects.blurb_en: A state-in-one distributed actor engine: compute and storage unified, no SQL and no external cache lock.

projects.name: Induction
projects.blurb: 常驻扩展进程的宿主协议：命名可执行文件、spawn、握手、投递带类型的帧、提供 ctx 面。
projects.blurb_en: A host protocol for resident extension processes: name an executable, spawn it, handshake, deliver typed frames and serve the ctx arms.

projects.name: Mudra
projects.blurb: 键盘优先的浏览器模式，用来精炼信息流。
projects.blurb_en: A keyboard-first browser mode for refining the information inflow.

projects.name: Fluxen
projects.blurb: AI 原生 UI 渲染库：Accrete DSL、Leptos 渲染、操作协议与 CBOR 编解码。
projects.blurb_en: An AI-native UI rendering library: the Accrete DSL, Leptos rendering, the operation protocol and a CBOR codec.

README.blurb: 项目入口：它是什么、三个接口面、crate 怎么划分。
README.blurb_en: The front door: what it is, the three surfaces, how the crates divide.

PLAN.blurb: 施工清单：分阶段的任务与验收条件，勾选表示已落地。
PLAN.blurb_en: The build checklist: phased tasks with their acceptance, ticked when landed.

MODELING.blurb: 数据建模：有哪些表、键与行的形状、声明了哪些访问面。
MODELING.blurb_en: Data modeling: which tables exist, their key and row shapes, which access faces are declared.

SEAM.blurb: 消费边界台账：每道门到核心原语到表，按消费方的操作组织。
SEAM.blurb_en: The consumer ledger: every door to a core primitive to a table, organised by consumer operation.

PROMPTS.blurb: 活的提示面：主动添加事实的工具定义，与写侧的胶囊生成器。
PROMPTS.blurb_en: The live prompt surface: the active-add tool definition and the write-side capsule generator.

0001-interface-surfaces.blurb: 三个接口面：会话控制、记忆、任务；一个面是一族核心门。
0001-interface-surfaces.blurb_en: Three interface surfaces — session control, memory, tasks; a surface is a family of core doors.

0002-storage-fjall-okm.blurb: Fjall 做存储引擎，全部 schema 用 OKM 声明式派生，PG 那套退场。
0002-storage-fjall-okm.blurb_en: Fjall as the storage engine, every schema declared through OKM derive macros; the PG form retires.

0003-retrieval-self-built.blurb: 检索用内置的小 embedding 模型在进程内跑：查询着陆，答案取着陆到的那个社区。
0003-retrieval-self-built.blurb_en: Retrieval runs a small embedding model in-process: the query lands, and the answer is the community it landed in.

0004-fact-contract.blurb: 事实契约：核心只收结构化的 8 槽元组，从不调用 LLM，判断归调用方。
0004-fact-contract.blurb_en: The fact contract: core takes structured 8-slot tuples and never calls an LLM; judgement is the caller's.

0005-weight-system.blurb: 权重：计数住在边这一行上，读写比划出四象限，检索按权重取 Top-K。
0005-weight-system.blurb_en: Weights: the counters ride the edge row, the read/write ratio splits four quadrants, retrieval is weight-ordered Top-K.

0006-stateless-agent-session-as-data.blurb: 会话即数据：agent 读自己的投影、追加自己的记录，从不改写历史。
0006-stateless-agent-session-as-data.blurb_en: Session as data: an agent reads its own projection and appends its own records, never mutating history.

0007-consumption-boundary.blurb: 消费边界：唯一跨进程形态是 HTTP 服务，纯 Rust，没有 Python 层。
0007-consumption-boundary.blurb_en: The consumption boundary: HTTP is the only cross-process form — pure Rust, no Python layer.

0008-unified-channel-log.blurb: 统一 channel 日志：人的消息与 LLM 对话同一个容器，上下文是投影，压缩是启发式。
0008-unified-channel-log.blurb_en: One channel log for human messages and the LLM conversation; context is a projection, compression is heuristic.

0009-multi-party-participation.blurb: 多方参与：身份分两层（成员行与画像事实），插话策略复用同一套信号。
0009-multi-party-participation.blurb_en: Multi-party participation: identity has two layers — a members row and profile facts — and the interrupt policy reuses the same signals.

0010-algorithm-improvement.blurb: 算法改进：写时消解实体，再自动认知分箱，给每个节点定社区。
0010-algorithm-improvement.blurb_en: Write-time entity resolution, then automatic cognitive binning that assigns every node a community.

0011-structured-log.blurb: 结构化日志：内部状态写成可丢的诊断行，按时间键，有行数上限。
0011-structured-log.blurb_en: The structured log: internal state as disposable diagnostic rows, keyed by time and capped in rows.

0012-code-store.blurb: 代码仓：交付的脚本按裸代理 id 一行一个，有自己的 ns。
0012-code-store.blurb_en: The code store: delivered scripts, one row per piece of code, keyed by a bare surrogate id.

0013-bulk-export.blurb: 备份是一个 Parquet 包裹加仓库元数据，能被没见过 k10r 的工具读回来。
0013-bulk-export.blurb_en: A backup is one Parquet bundle with warehouse metadata, readable by a tool that never saw k10r.

0014-member-as-node.blurb: 成员就是节点：身份行加入事实图，成为图中的用户节点集合。
0014-member-as-node.blurb_en: The member is a node: identity rows join the fact graph as its user node set.

graph-memory.blurb: 记忆架构的计算时机光谱，以及属性图在 agent 记忆里的定位。
graph-memory.blurb_en: The compute-timing spectrum of memory architectures, and where the property graph sits.

kv-storage-engine.blurb: KV 引擎的架构设计、复合键编码与用例。
kv-storage-engine.blurb_en: KV engine architecture, composite key encoding, and use cases.

agent-memory.blurb: 记忆架构选型：从文档走到原子事实。
agent-memory.blurb_en: Memory architecture selection: from documents down to atomic facts.

stateless-agent-architecture.blurb: 无状态 agent 架构：回合、技能、记忆三者怎么分工。
stateless-agent-architecture.blurb_en: The stateless agent architecture: how turns, skills and memory divide the work.

property-graph-queries.blurb: SQL/PGQ 属性图查询的形态与边界。
property-graph-queries.blurb_en: SQL/PGQ property-graph queries: their shape and their limits.

krystallizer.blurb: 这个记忆核心自己的设计文档（wiki 版）。
krystallizer.blurb_en: The memory core's own design document, in its wiki rendition.
